THE FAMILY IS EXACTLY THE THIRTEEN DENSITY ROWS OF ONE PRIME'S SR3 v3 EVALUATION. It is not a family across primes. THIS GATE IS LESS SENSITIVE TO A SMALL GENUINE BASELINE REGRESSION THAN A 95% PER-ROW GATE WOULD BE. Widening each row's acceptance interval from 95% to 99.6154% coverage buys the family-wise property by paying in per-row power, and no measurement of that power exists because no sampling distribution exists. THE CONSEQUENCE, STATED SO IT CANNOT BE MISREAD LATER: IF A FUTURE RUN PASSES THIS GATE, THAT IS NOT EVIDENCE OF NO REGRESSION BELOW ITS DETECTION FLOOR. The gate certifies admissibility, not the absence of a small drift, and any record citing a pass must carry this sentence with it.

THE GATE EVALUATES THIRTEEN ROWS AND PER-ROW COVERAGE COMPOUNDS. At 95%
per-row coverage a GENUINE reproduction fails somewhere with probability
1 - 0.95^13 = 0.486658, that is 48.7% of the time. At 99% per-row it is
1 - 0.99^13 = 0.122479, that is 12.25%. Both prior terminations of
EXP-ICINV-4d33aa were ADMISSIBILITY FAILURES ON GENUINE REPRODUCTIONS --
at version 2 the re-measured baseline reproduced Arm A0 at 13 of 13 rows
with delta 0.0 and the gate still failed, on two low-density rows -- which
is exactly the signature of an uncorrected per-row threshold applied
thirteen times.

FAMILY-WISE CONTROL FIXES THE FAILURE MODE RATHER THAN MERELY LOOSENING
THE NUMBER. It is deliberately conservative against a true regression, and
that is the right direction after two false stops. The realised family-wise
error at the declared per-row coverage is 0.048862, marginally under the
0.05 target, which is the usual conservatism of Bonferroni and is recorded
rather than rounded away.

The interval at each row is the CENTRAL interval of that row's reference
sampling distribution between those two quantiles. A candidate arm's
per-density-row variance ratio passes SR3 v3 at that row if and only if it
lies inside that row's interval, and passes the gate if and only if it
passes at every one of the thirteen rows.

NUMBERED AND STATED AS A HEURISTIC, NOT ASSUMED: the Gaussian tail is an adequate approximation to the far tail of the reference run's per-row sampling distribution of the variance-ratio statistic at coverage 259/260. IT IS AN APPROXIMATION AND THE COVERAGE CHOSEN IS PRECISELY WHERE SUCH APPROXIMATIONS ARE WEAKEST. Its validation is the existing tail check -- the extreme per-seed ratios at each row are listed, so the interval's endpoints can be seen rather than trusted -- together with the rung-wise half-widths of E2. If the listed extremes are visibly asymmetric or heavy-tailed relative to the fitted interval, that is reported as an instrument finding and the gate is redesigned under a further versioned amendment; it is never absorbed silently.

A PARAMETRIC WILSON-HILFERTY BAND, recomputed per row from that row's own degrees of freedom, is available and is already used elsewhere in this lane (EXP-ICINV-4d33aa controls). IT WAS REJECTED HERE because the user's selected gate replacement, recorded in DEC-20260810-a4bec4, is a comparison against the reference run's OWN EMPIRICAL sampling uncertainty, and substituting a parametric band would change the gate the user chose rather than implement it. E1 keeps the estimator anchored on the measured per-row mean and sd and confines the distributional assumption to the tail rule alone, which is the smallest such assumption that reaches the declared coverage.

E1. ESTIMATOR. At each density row the central interval is
mean +- z * sd, where mean and sd are the EMPIRICAL mean and standard
deviation of the variance-ratio statistic over the declared seed set at
that row, and z = Phi^{-1}(519/520) (approximately 2.8905). The run
COMPUTES z at run time from the frozen coverage; transcribing it, or any
other reference value, into source at any precision is PROHIBITED and
makes the run INVALID (the standing A4 rule carried from
EXP-ICINV-4d33aa amendment v2).

E2. SEED RUNGS FOR THE SR3 v3 CHARACTERISATION ONLY. 12, then 24, then 48.
Rung 1 is the contract's twelve declared seeds, UNCHANGED. Rung 2 adds
seeds 20260821 to 20260832 inclusive. Rung 3 adds seeds 20260833 to
20260856 inclusive. The interval, its half-width and the extreme per-seed
ratios are reported at EVERY rung reached, which is what makes
C-SEED-STABILITY a measurement rather than an assertion.

E3. STABILITY RULE. The characterisation may stop at a rung if the
interval half-width changes by less than 5% relative to the previous rung
at EVERY one of the thirteen rows. If that is not met at rung 3, the
interval HAS NOT STABILISED, HEUR-INSTR-2 is not validated at 48 seeds,
falsification criterion F4 fires, the work STOPS and the Coordinator is
told. The interval is NOT widened and the coverage is NOT changed.

E4. SR1'S SEEDS ARE UNCHANGED. The twelve contract seeds govern SR1 and
are not re-cut; SR1 data already exists and re-cutting its seed set after
seeing it would be post-hoc.

E5. BUDGET IS NOT INCREASED BY THIS CHANGE. The contract's budget stands
(14400 s per run, 24 CPU-hours, 8 GB, 20 runs). No per-seed cost for the
SR3 v3 characterisation has ever been measured, so if the budget is
reached before rung 3, the run reports the rungs it completed, records the
remainder as not_measured, and that is a BUDGET EVENT under AGENTS.md
rule 5 -- never a pass and never negative evidence about any instrument.

A COVERAGE WITHOUT AN ESTIMATOR IS STILL UNEXECUTABLE, AND THE ARITHMETIC IS UNFORGIVING: the declared interval endpoints are the 1/520 and 519/520 quantiles, and TWELVE DRAWS CANNOT RESOLVE A 1/520 TAIL QUANTILE BY ORDER STATISTICS AT ALL. Declaring G2 alone would send Phase A back with the identical class of defect, one step further in. This change is therefore made now, with the same no-data-in-view property as G2.

L2. THE SINGLE-VERTEX RANK ARM IS DISCRETE AND ITS LEVEL IS NOT 0.05. The
exact permutation rank at n = 1 against an enumerated class of size n
attains only the probabilities k/n. At the design figure n = 37 the
smallest attainable one-sided probability is 1/37 = 0.027027 and the
smallest two-sided one is 2/37 = 0.054054, which EXCEEDS 0.05. The frozen
rule for that arm is therefore: report the ONE-SIDED exact permutation
probability, reject only at the strict extreme, and compare the
matched-null (pseudo-crater) flag rate against 1/n -- exactly 0.027027 at
n = 37 -- and NOT against 0.05. If the enumeration returns a class size
other than 37, n is the ENUMERATED size, the rule is unchanged, and the
realised level is 1/n at that size. The enumerated count is authoritative
over the class-number formula and over the design document
(DEC-20260810-a4bec4, Deuring caveat).

inputs.planting_rule.sweep and stopping_rules SR3 -- the PLANTED-SIZE LADDER

BOTH LADDERS ARE COORDINATOR-SET, ANCHORED TO COMMITTED FIGURES RATHER THAN INVENTED, AND NEITHER IS DERIVED FROM ANY MEASUREMENT. LADDER-M brackets the committed NULL-C profile's own span, which runs from 0.38% to 3.79% of the pooled mean (the "as % of mean" column of red_team_notes.md section 5, reproduced exactly by RUN-INSTR-36c8cf-phaseA-2a5cd1): the maximum 4.00% sits just above the published top rung and the minimum 0.10% sits a factor of about four below the published bottom rung, so the published profile's whole range lies strictly inside the ladder. LADDER-V brackets the committed detection-bound table, whose variance-ratio floors run from 1.250 at n = 138, T = 400 to 3.668 at n = 3, T = 300 (red_team_notes.md section 6, read at run time and recorded in the run's raw-result.json): the maximum 4.00 sits above the worst committed floor and the minimum 1.10 below the best, so every committed cell's floor is bracketed by the ladder rather than clipped by it.

LADDER-M, FOR EVERY MEAN-SHIFT CONSTRUCTION (the between-class monotone
shift, the within-class per-level shift, and the single-vertex crater
shift). The planted size is expressed as a PERCENTAGE OF THE POOLED MEAN
OF THE STATISTIC WITHIN THAT CELL'S OWN GEOMETRY, computed inside the run,
which makes the unit construction-free and geometry-independent. Rungs,
swept DOWNWARD in this order:
4.00, 2.00, 1.00, 0.50, 0.25, 0.10 percent of mean.
maximum 4.00 percent, minimum 0.10 percent.

LADDER-V, FOR THE WITHIN-CLASS CHI-SQUARE DISPERSION STATISTIC, whose unit
is a variance ratio and NOT a mean shift. The planted size is a
variance-ratio multiplier. Rungs, swept DOWNWARD:
4.00, 3.00, 2.00, 1.50, 1.25, 1.10.
maximum 4.00, minimum 1.10.

SIGN RULE, BINDING ON BOTH LADDERS AND ON EVERY CELL. Each rung is run in
BOTH SIGNS relative to the cell's own measured ordering (the class-mean
ordering for a between-class cell, the level ordering for a within-class
cell), and THE DETECTION FLOOR IS REPORTED PER SIGN AND NEVER POOLED
ACROSS SIGNS. The measured fact MF1 below is why.

EXHAUSTION REPORTING. If detection has not failed at the minimum rung, the
floor is reported as "below the ladder minimum, unresolved by this ladder"
-- never as the minimum. If detection never succeeds at the maximum rung,
the floor is reported as "at or above the ladder maximum, unresolved by
this ladder", and that cell BLOCKS its lane conclusion exactly as an
unmeasured cell does.

THE TWO LADDERS ARE IN DIFFERENT UNITS AND MAY NOT BE MIXED. A percentage of a mean is not a variance ratio, and the detection-bound table's excess_sd_pct column is a dispersion quantity that is NOT interchangeable with a mean shift of the same numeric size. Any run that applies LADDER-M to a dispersion statistic, or LADDER-V to a mean detector, has committed a unit error and its floors are void.

AN ADDITIVE BETWEEN-CLASS SHIFT IS CONSTRUCTIVE OR DESTRUCTIVE BY SIGN. In the invalid run's enumeration, FIVE gradient-aligned constructions (ladder_unit, ladder_total, ladder_centered, top_class_up, halves_aligned) reached power 1.00 at delta = 0.002, while the TWO gradient-opposed ones (bottom_class_up, halves_antialigned) had not reached power 1.00 even at delta = 0.005. SIGN MATTERS, AND A CONSTRUCTION'S MEASURED POWER IS NOT PORTABLE ACROSS SIGN. This is the direct reason for the sign rule in change G6.

THE FOUR COMMITTED p = 4001 CLASSES ALREADY CARRY AN ORDERED CLASS-MEAN GRADIENT IN THE UNPERTURBED DATA. The per-class means of decomposition_rate_m3 are 0.52395 (t = -30), 0.52500 (t = -18), 0.52954 (t = 18) and 0.53060 (t = 30) -- ascending in trace order -- at class sizes {-30: 138, -18: 98, 18: 98, 30: 138}, pooled mean 0.527272.

IT IS AN INSTRUMENT PROPERTY OF A PLANTING GEOMETRY, NOT A CURVE, CLASS OR ISOGENY FINDING, AND IT MAY NOT BE CITED AS ONE AT ANY SCALE. It says that four measured class means are not equal and are ordered; it says nothing about why. Nothing here bears on H-ICINV-6c7920, on EV-ENDO-10109d, on endomorphism structure, on |D_0|, or on ECDLP difficulty in any direction.

THE CONTRACT SUCCEEDS WHEN EVERY DECLARED CELL IS CHARACTERISED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS AND THE SR3 v3 REFERENCE CHARACTERISATION IS DELIVERED -- not when a particular instrument turns out to be good. Concretely, ALL of the following hold: (1) SR1 passes; (2) for every (statistic, geometry, density row) cell declared by EXP-JINV-bd141d and EXP-VOLC-9f5571, a measured detection floor and a measured matched-null false-positive rate are reported, with any cell the budget did not reach listed explicitly as not_measured together with the lane conclusion it BLOCKS; (3) the pseudo-crater, arbitrary-halves, label-permutation and nuisance-direction controls are all reported; (4) NULL-C's admissibility for the between-class matched-order contrast is characterised afresh, including its median p at zero planted shift on that geometry; (5) the SR3 v3 per-density-row sampling distribution is delivered with its central interval, its width against seed count, and its self-consistency verdict; and (6) the report states plainly that the superseded [1.3, 3.6] band was the outward-rounded hull of the committed rows it gated (floor slack 0.020397, ceiling slack 0.011900) and that this -- not a failure of the campaign's finding -- is why literal band membership is being replaced, together with the cost the chosen replacement imposes. A statistic that FAILS either direction is a successful outcome of this contract: the deliverable is a blocked lane conclusion with a named replacement statistic and its cost, not a pass.
SMALLEST-STRATUM CELL. The cell at the smallest stratum -- expected to be the crater -- is reported explicitly with its floor, not folded into an average across strata.
NULL TAIL. The full distribution of the matched-null statistic is reported per cell, not merely its exceedance rate, so a heavy tail is visible.
SR3 v3 INTERVAL TAILS. The extreme per-seed variance ratios at each density row are listed, so the interval's endpoints can be seen rather than trusted.

NOT-MEASURED LEDGER. Every (statistic, geometry, density row) cell the budget did not reach is listed explicitly as not_measured, together with the lane conclusion it thereby BLOCKS. An unmeasured control is not a passed control.

Two-directional instrument control -- planted-signal detection AND matched-null rejection -- for every statistic EXP-JINV-bd141d and EXP-VOLC-9f5571 rely on, run at THEIR ACTUAL GEOMETRY; and delivery of the reference-run per-density-row sampling characterisation without which the redesigned SR3 gate (protocol_amendment v3) cannot be evaluated.
